import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "tests.filtered_relation",
    ],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection
from django.db.models import Case, F, FilteredRelation, Q, When
from tests.filtered_relation.models import Author, Book, Editor

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Author)
    se.create_model(Editor)
    se.create_model(Book)

ed = Editor.objects.create(name="e")
a = Author.objects.create(name="a")
Book.objects.create(title="b1", author=a, editor=ed, state="available")
Book.objects.create(title="b2", author=a, editor=ed, state="rented")

qs = (
    Book.objects.alias(
        relation_available=FilteredRelation(
            "editor",
            condition=Q(editor__name="e"),
        ),
        relation_rented=FilteredRelation(
            "editor",
            condition=Q(editor__state="rented"),
        ),
        state_available=F("relation_available__state"),
        state_rented=F("relation_rented__state"),
    )
    .annotate(
        state_final=Case(
            When(state_rented__isnull=True, then=F("state_available")),
            default=F("state_rented"),
        )
    )
)
print(str(qs.query))
print("---- results ----")
for b in qs:
    print(b.title, b.state_available, b.state_rented, b.state_final)
